title: Evidence log (content produced by the agent in the investigation phase)
description: What Hermes must submit via submit_evidence_log: which plan steps were executed with which tool, why, what came back (found / none / failed) and the evidence refs the tools returned. No severity, verdict or recommendation (those come on Day 3).

executed_steps.description: One entry per plan step that was run with an evidence tool (search_logs, lookup_ip, search_cve, get_asset_context). analyst_review steps never go here.

tool.description: The evidence tool used (must be the tool the plan step names).

outcome.description: found = the tool returned evidence (cite its refs); none = the tool worked but returned nothing relevant (no refs); failed = the tool errored or timed out (no refs, never a guess).

items.description: an evidence_ref exactly as a tool returned it, e.g. wazuh_alerts.jsonl#L57

evidence_refs.description: Up to 20 exact evidence_ref strings returned by this step's tool in this run (pick the most relevant). Must be [] unless outcome is found.

skipped_steps.description: Plan steps that were not run, e.g. analyst_review (human-only). Each entry has exactly step, tool and reason (no outcome, no evidence_refs).
